name: @pipeworx/mcp-tiingo

tools.name: stock_prices
tools.description: Get EOD historical stock prices for a ticker (open, high, low, close, volume, adjClose). Without a start_date, returns just the latest trading day. Example: stock_prices({ ticker: "AAPL", start_date: "2024-01-01", end_date: "2024-01-31", frequency: "daily" })

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. "AAPL", "MSFT", "TSLA". Share classes accept either separator — "BRK.B" and "BRK-B" both work.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional). Omit to get only the latest day.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Tiingo API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: stock_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata for a stock ticker: company name, description, exchange code, and the date range of available EOD price data. Example: stock_metadata({ ticker: "AAPL" })

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. "AAPL". Share classes accept either separator — "BRK.B" and "BRK-B" both work.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Tiingo API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: news
tools.description: Get recent financial news articles, optionally filtered by tickers or tags. Returns title, description, URL, published date, source, and related tickers. Requires a caller-supplied Tiingo API key on the News-tier plan (Power or higher) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: news({ tickers: "aapl,msft", limit: 10, _apiKey: "your_tiingo_key" })

limit.description: Number of articles to return (default 10, max 100)

_apiKey.description: Your own Tiingo API key on a plan that includes the News API (Power tier or higher — tiingo.com/about/pricing). The shared Pipeworx key is on a lower plan and cannot reach this endpoint, unlike the other tools in this pack.

tools.name: crypto_prices
tools.description: Get crypto prices for a pair (open, high, low, close, volume) at a chosen resample frequency. Example: crypto_prices({ ticker: "btcusd", resampleFreq: "1day" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Tiingo API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tiingo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tiingo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
